metadata.description: Golden retrieval set built from title and abstract_text fields in random_300_articles.csv. Questions intentionally mix exact-title, acronym, paraphrase, method-focused, and near-neighbor edge cases.

questions.question: Which paper proposes sliding-window KV cache quantization that keeps the most recent window tokens at high precision for long-context LLM inference?
questions.expected_title: SKVQ: Sliding-window Key and Value Cache Quantization for Large Language Models
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve SKVQ, not the broader transformer training paper about KV cache compressibility.

questions.question: Which work argues that KV cache compressibility is a learned representation property and trains transformers toward more compressible internal states?
questions.expected_title: Training Transformers for KV Cache Compressibility
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the transformer-training compressibility paper rather than SKVQ or ChunkKV-style post-hoc compression methods.

questions.question: What text-to-SQL paper calibrates LLM confidence by using SQL sub-clause frequencies and Platt scaling instead of raw model probabilities?
questions.expected_title: Calibrating LLMs for Text-to-SQL Parsing by Leveraging Sub-clause Frequencies
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the sub-clause frequency calibration paper.

questions.question: Which benchmark evaluates natural-language-to-PostGIS generation with spatial data types, coordinate systems, PostGIS functions, and schema retrieval tasks?
questions.expected_title: GeoSQL-Eval: First Evaluation of LLMs on PostGIS-Based NL2GeoSQL Queries
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve GeoSQL-Eval / GeoSQL-Bench.

questions.question: Which image generation approach simulates photo-realistic floods on user-provided photos by combining simulated and real data through unsupervised domain adaptation?
questions.expected_title: ClimateGAN: Raising Climate Change Awareness by Generating Images of Floods
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve ClimateGAN.

questions.question: Which framework lets foundation agents control arbitrary software through screenshots as observations and keyboard or mouse actions as outputs?
questions.expected_title: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents Towards General Computer Control
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Cradle and the General Computer Control setting.

questions.question: What LLM-agent system decides whether a web attack requires a new intrusion detection rule or a repair to an existing signature?
questions.expected_title: GRIDAI: Generating and Repairing Intrusion Detection Rules via Collaboration among Multiple LLM-based Agents
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve GRIDAI.

questions.question: Which practical study converts fake low-precision quantization into true 8-bit GPU inference for 3D medical segmentation networks such as U-Net and SwinUNETR?
questions.expected_title: Post-Training Quantization for 3D Medical Image Segmentation: A Practical Study on Real Inference Engines
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the real PTQ / TensorRT-style 3D medical segmentation quantization paper.

questions.question: Which CI/CD framework performs token-efficient log preprocessing, root-cause analysis, retrieval of historical fixes, and tool-calling based remediation?
questions.expected_title: LogSage: An LLM-Based Framework for CI/CD Failure Detection and Remediation with Industrial Validation
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve LogSage.

questions.question: Which Arabic NLP dataset and metric treats dialectness as a continuous sentence-level variable rather than binary dialect identification?
questions.expected_title: ALDi: Quantifying the Arabic Level of Dialectness of Text
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve ALDi / AOC-ALDi.

questions.question: Which IoT networking architecture for constrained devices offers modular interfaces, heterogeneous protocol stacks, and GNRC as a cleanly layered default stack?
questions.expected_title: Connecting the World of Embedded Mobiles: The RIOT Approach to Ubiquitous Networking for the Internet of Things
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the RIOT networking architecture paper.

questions.question: Which survey reviews code-switched NLP in the LLM era across modalities, many languages, datasets, tasks, and evaluation biases?
questions.expected_title: Beyond Monolingual Assumptions: A Survey of Code-Switched NLP in the Era of Large Language Models across Modalities
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the broad code-switched NLP survey, not the speech translation model.

questions.question: Which end-to-end model translates code-switched Indian speech to English by interleaving aligned speech and ASR text representations before machine translation?
questions.expected_title: CoSTA: Code-Switched Speech Translation using Aligned Speech-Text Interleaving
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve CoSTA, not the general code-switched NLP survey.

questions.question: Which paper studies how retrieval-augmented LLM agents can learn from retrieved trajectories in-context using LoRA fine-tuning recipes?
questions.expected_title: Retrieval-Augmented LLM Agents: Learning to Learn from Experience
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the retrieval-augmented LLM agents paper.

questions.question: Which human-LLM ideation system extracts purposes, mechanisms, and evaluations from papers so users can recombine facets and verify novelty?
questions.expected_title: Human-LLM Compound System for Scientific Ideation through Facet Recombination and Novelty Evaluation
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Scideator / facet recombination scientific ideation.

questions.question: Which review organizes Vision-Language-Action models around perception, language understanding, embodied action, planners, and hierarchical controllers?
questions.expected_title: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models: Concepts, Progress, Applications and Challenges
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the VLA models survey.

questions.question: Which theoretical paper uses category theory to ask when prompt-based learning can solve downstream tasks and says prompts work only for representable tasks?
questions.expected_title: On the Power of Foundation Models
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the category-theoretic foundation model power paper.

questions.question: Which LLM training approach improves algorithm execution by supervised reasoning decomposition and is applied to an arithmetic function?
questions.expected_title: Large Language Models and Algorithm Execution: Application to an Arithmetic Function
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve LLM-DAL / decompositional algorithmic learning.

questions.question: Which BabyLM study finds larger GPT-like models can improve linguistic benchmarks while fitting human reading-time measures worse?
questions.expected_title: Large GPT-like Models are Bad Babies: A Closer Look at the Relationship between Linguistic Competence and Psycholinguistic Measures
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the Bad Babies GPT-like model paper.

questions.question: Which continual LLM learning architecture composes frozen MoE-LoRA adapter stacks with null-space projection and an outcome-based meta-router?
questions.expected_title: Brainstacks: Cross-Domain Cognitive Capabilities via Frozen MoE-LoRA Stacks for Continual LLM Learning
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Brainstacks.

questions.question: Which system combines password-based authentication with encrypted data storage for untrusted cloud-like environments?
questions.expected_title: AuthStore: Password-based Authentication and Encrypted Data Storage in Untrusted Environments
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve AuthStore, not Authcoin.

questions.question: Which decentralized authentication proposal validates public keys using a blockchain-style network rather than relying on a central certificate authority?
questions.expected_title: Authcoin: Validation and Authentication in Decentralized Networks
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Authcoin, not AuthStore.

questions.question: Which anti-phishing model uses hierarchical LSTMs and supervised attention to detect phishing websites or emails?
questions.expected_title: A Deep Learning Model with Hierarchical LSTMs and Supervised Attention for Anti-Phishing
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the hierarchical LSTM supervised-attention anti-phishing paper.

questions.question: Which work proposes reliable smart road signs as an infrastructure safety concept for road users or intelligent transport?
questions.expected_title: Reliable Smart Road Signs
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Reliable Smart Road Signs.

questions.question: Which tool detects license incompatibilities in open source software projects?
questions.expected_title: LiDetector: License Incompatibility Detection for Open Source Software
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve LiDetector.

questions.question: Which paper discusses continuous integration and continuous delivery practices for automated deployment of machine learning models using MLOps?
questions.expected_title: On Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery for Automated Deployment of Machine Learning Models using MLOps
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the MLOps CI/CD deployment paper, not LogSage.

questions.question: Which clinical EEG report generation architecture balances compression with guaranteed measurement accuracy?
questions.expected_title: Bridging the Compression-Precision Paradox: A Hybrid Architecture for Clinical EEG Report Generation with Guaranteed Measurement Accuracy
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the hybrid clinical EEG report generation paper.

questions.question: Which network segments the prostate in micro-ultrasound images using a deep learning approach?
questions.expected_title: MicroSegNet: A Deep Learning Approach for Prostate Segmentation on Micro-Ultrasound Images
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve MicroSegNet, not prostate MR segmentation papers.

questions.question: Which explainable multitask model performs breast ultrasound cancer diagnosis using BI-RADS related outputs?
questions.expected_title: BI-RADS-Net: An Explainable Multitask Learning Approach for Cancer Diagnosis in Breast Ultrasound Images
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve BI-RADS-Net.

questions.question: Which method structures transfer-ready medical image representations through discrete self-supervision?
questions.expected_title: DiSSECT: Structuring Transfer-Ready Medical Image Representations through Discrete Self-Supervision
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve DiSSECT.

questions.question: Which prostate MRI segmentation approach uses a boundary-weighted domain adaptive neural network?
questions.expected_title: Boundary-weighted Domain Adaptive Neural Network for Prostate MR Image Segmentation
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the boundary-weighted domain adaptive prostate MR segmentation paper.

questions.question: Which GAN framework guides murine hippocampal subregion segmentation using regions of interest?
questions.expected_title: ROIsGAN: A Region Guided Generative Adversarial Framework for Murine Hippocampal Subregion Segmentation
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve ROIsGAN.

questions.question: Which robotic surgery paper targets unsupervised instrument segmentation with cycle-consistent adversarial networks?
questions.expected_title: Towards Unsupervised Learning for Instrument Segmentation in Robotic Surgery with Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the unsupervised robotic surgery instrument segmentation paper.

questions.question: Which benchmark suite evaluates offline reinforcement learning for autonomous driving with value-based datasets?
questions.expected_title: AD4RL: Autonomous Driving Benchmarks for Offline Reinforcement Learning with Value-based Dataset
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve AD4RL.

questions.question: Which reinforcement learning paper describes three regimes for moving from offline data to online interaction?
questions.expected_title: The Three Regimes of Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve The Three Regimes of Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning.

questions.question: Which Bayesian reinforcement learning method uses residual policy optimization with clairvoyant experts?
questions.expected_title: Bayesian Residual Policy Optimization: Scalable Bayesian Reinforcement Learning with Clairvoyant Experts
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Bayesian Residual Policy Optimization.

questions.question: Which lifelong reinforcement learning method combines temporal logic formulas with reward machines?
questions.expected_title: Lifelong Reinforcement Learning with Temporal Logic Formulas and Reward Machines
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve the temporal-logic reward-machine lifelong RL paper.

questions.question: Which multi-fidelity reinforcement learning method uses Gaussian processes and multiple simulators of increasing fidelity to reduce real-world samples?
questions.expected_title: Multi-Fidelity Reinforcement Learning with Gaussian Processes
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Multi-Fidelity Reinforcement Learning with Gaussian Processes.

questions.question: Which variational autoencoder uses blocked neurons and a hierarchy inspired by information bottleneck and information maximization to disentangle representations?
questions.expected_title: Blocked and Hierarchical Disentangled Representation From Information Theory Perspective
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve BHiVAE.

questions.question: Which representation learning paper replaces mutual-information objectives with a Wasserstein dependency measure to avoid high-MI sample complexity issues?
questions.expected_title: Wasserstein Dependency Measure for Representation Learning
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Wasserstein Dependency Measure.

questions.question: Which calibration paper studies statistical bias in expected calibration error estimates and compares equal-mass versus equal-width binning?
questions.expected_title: Mitigating Bias in Calibration Error Estimation
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Mitigating Bias in Calibration Error Estimation, not the text-to-SQL calibration paper.

questions.question: Which fairness paper adapts group fairness metrics to survival analysis and evaluates bias across many survival datasets?
questions.expected_title: Flexible Group Fairness Metrics for Survival Analysis
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Flexible Group Fairness Metrics for Survival Analysis.

questions.question: Which federated learning method adds adaptive conformal prediction to provide distribution-free prediction sets for clinical deployment?
questions.expected_title: Distribution-Free Federated Learning with Conformal Predictions
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Distribution-Free Federated Learning with Conformal Predictions.

questions.question: Which private data release method accelerates MWEM from linear query scanning to expected square-root dependence using lazy Gumbel sampling and kNN?
questions.expected_title: Fast-MWEM: Private Data Release in Sublinear Time
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Fast-MWEM.

questions.question: Which bandit paper shows that optimal linear bandit algorithms can suffer linear regret under sparse additive misspecification?
questions.expected_title: Misspecified Linear Bandits
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Misspecified Linear Bandits.

questions.question: Which exploration method uses an adversarial discriminator objective so model-based curiosity can scale in robotics-style prediction-planning pipelines?
questions.expected_title: An Adversarial Objective for Scalable Exploration
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve An Adversarial Objective for Scalable Exploration.

questions.question: Which mobile robot exploration method builds a Gaussian-process occupancy map, derives probabilistic frontiers, and uses mutual information for greedy exploration?
questions.expected_title: Gaussian Process Autonomous Mapping and Exploration for Range Sensing Mobile Robots
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve Gaussian Process Autonomous Mapping and Exploration.

questions.question: Which low-cost one-wheel-drive robot is designed to inspect electrical power transmission lines continuously and reduce maintenance risk?
questions.expected_title: ROSETLineBot: One-Wheel-Drive Low-Cost Power Line Inspection Robot Design and Control
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve ROSETLineBot.

questions.question: Which underwater tracker for marine organism grasping combines underwater/open-air hybrid training with motion-based post-processing?
questions.expected_title: Underwater Object Tracker: UOSTrack for Marine Organism Grasping of Underwater Vehicles
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve UOSTrack.

questions.question: Which long-term visual place recognition benchmark studies view direction and data anonymization effects in a New York urban area?
questions.expected_title: NYU-VPR: Long-Term Visual Place Recognition Benchmark with View Direction and Data Anonymization Influences
questions.expected_outcome: Retrieve NYU-VPR.
